clarified_intent.description: Refine and validate the optional React entity-graph inspector, its public entries, documentation, screenshots, evidence, and archive claims against the accepted ui-spec.

constraints: The ordinary React root must exclude the inspector; ./devtools must be side-effect-free and ./devtools/auto must mount only after explicit development opt-in.
Overview, Entities, Views, Activity, and Graph Pulse must use controller-owned projections and truthful registered-view causality.
Original, patch, live, diff, preview/restore, history, rewind, and return-live semantics must match the core controller.
Serialized transports must remain metadata-only unless a host explicitly includes and redacts values.
The UI must retain semantic controls, keyboard and screen-reader workflows, visible focus, responsive layouts, deferred search, virtualization, bounded cadence, and reduced motion.
The three React runtime entries, skills, package README, root README, Docusaurus pages, and generated API reference must agree.
The mandatory 12-developer formative usability gate cannot be replaced by automated evidence.

target_state.description: A deterministic artifact packet with truthful automated evidence and an explicit archive decision for every blocking ui-spec criterion.
success_criteria: Packed Vite/Next/Chromium acceptance passes with no production-root inspector reachability.
React root, ./devtools, and ./devtools/auto runtime ledgers match their built artifacts.
Generated API documentation passes its stable-export coverage policy.
Screenshots visibly demonstrate the causal inspector and responsive 500-event surface.
Adversarial and sycophancy reviews contain no unresolved blocking finding.
At least 10 of 12 retained study participants complete both seeded tasks without assistance and each cohort median is under 10 seconds.

unknowns: No retained formative-study participant record has been found; archive readiness therefore remains provisional until that human gate exists.
Impeccable was requested first but no installed skill/package was discoverable in the available skill roots or searched local paths.
